headers.comment: The dashboard JS drives multi-pass pipeline stages: it calls the design and detect functions once per pass and knows how many passes there are. A browser holding a one-deploy-old copy therefore does not just look stale, it runs a DIFFERENT protocol against the current server — that is exactly how a run ended up applying a third of its proposals and still billing for the whole thing. There is no build step or content hash here, so revalidation is the only thing standing between a deploy and that class of bug.
